summary: Sysmenu 3: display model - window_mode enum, resolution and refresh lists
author: pm
body:
One window_mode key migrated from fullscreen/borderless booleans; SDL-style curated resolution list with aspect labels capped at the desktop; refresh list; one apply path for menu, start-up and Alt-Enter.

Plan: .claude/design/plans/system-menu-display-overhaul.md (part of HH-0114).

**Done when:** built, reviewed and checked in game.

**Decision, 2026-11-25 (d-038):** real refresh rate, specified in the engine-neutral graphics protocol (renderer/window interfaces) and implemented per backend; sfml_engine implements it. The whole display model goes through the protocol.
